## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are trying to address.
(e.g., "There is no auditor for checking SSL certificate expiry.")

Describe the feature or change you would like to see. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you have considered, and why you prefer your proposed solution.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples that would help clarify the request.
